product_rules.full_refresh: Use 0xF7 only for an unknown baseline or a transport/fault recovery. A normal menu boundary requests the vendor Mode 1 / 0xC7 fast path when the baseline is valid, with full as the policy fallback only when that baseline is unknown.
product_rules.generation_backlog: SCR-17 remains a named product backlog/release item; recognizable old faces, menus, prompt crops, fallback renderers, or framebuffer content are stale_generation_content until proven physical afterimage only.
product_rules.generation_swap: Treat visual ghosting and old/new resource interleaving as separate failures: atomically activate one CEMP revision, drain stale queued frames, then refresh/maintain the panel baseline.
product_rules.generation_triage: Classify visible old content as physical afterimage, stale queued frame, stale asset revision, or rescue/procedural fallback leakage; only physical afterimage belongs to refresh-profile tuning.
product_rules.ghosting: Partial/fast refresh can accumulate ghosting; tune refresh profile/cadence rather than blending old art.
product_rules.interaction_serial: Production reuses the touch trace switch to remove successful screen enqueue, frame, pet-attention, and stroke UART serialization; failures and one reset-bounded coherent-generation marker remain visible for runtime evidence.
product_rules.interactive: Use differential 0xFC dirty-window refresh; coalesce queued menu drag frames to the latest request.
product_rules.maintenance: Ordinary touch never schedules a delayed cleanup. Five completed differential interactions are allowed; the sixth selects one Good Display Mode 1 / 0xC7 cleanup. Explicit menu enter/exit boundaries each request one Mode-1 cleanup.
product_rules.menu_boundary: Enter and exit request one vendor-profiled Mode 1 / 0xC7 fast waveform when the panel baseline is valid. The target logs the profile, activation count, and expected visible phase model; physical one-flicker confirmation remains a focused hardware gate.
product_rules.portability: Scene/player use portable refresh intents; WB55/WBA panel targets choose waveform details.

scope: SCR-16 screen feel and ghosting control; machine-static until the current candidate has real WB55 logs, then human feel remains pending
